portal./portal.js: window.handleGoogleCredential=function(response){if(!response||!response.credential)return;const box=document.querySelector('.login');box?.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');const form=document.createElement('form');form.method='post';form.action='/auth/google/continue';const input=document.createElement('input');input.type='hidden';input.name='credential';input.value=response.credential;form.appendChild(input);document.body.appendChild(form);form.submit()};function showMember(member){document.getElementById('signed-out').style.display='none';document.getElementById('signed-in').classList.add('visible');document.getElementById('member-name').textContent=member.displayName||'NEOpass Member';document.getElementById('member-status').textContent=member.neopassStatus==='active'?'NEOpass active · Member services available':'Google verified · Temple membership verification pending'}async function session(){const response=await fetch('/api/v1/auth/session',{cache:'no-store'});if(response.ok){const data=await response.json();if(data.authenticated)location.replace('/portal')}}document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{session();document.getElementById('logout')?.addEventListener('click',async()=>{await fetch('/api/v1/auth/logout',{method:'POST'});location.reload()})});
